milestones.title: Disc extracted
milestones.detail: main.dol + 2.5 GB of game data pulled from the PAL disc (RM7P4F).

milestones.title: Executable split & analysed
milestones.detail: decomp-toolkit finds 12,580 functions in 707 objects; game code at 0x80006B40–0x80232AF8.

milestones.title: Tooling
milestones.detail: Cross-reference, renaming and progress scripts; this site updates on every push.

milestones.title: Boot path decompiled
milestones.detail: main(), SDK init, heaps, reset/power handling, crash screen, top-level game loop.

milestones.title: Engine & game systems
milestones.detail: Engine init/frame/shutdown, UI engine, task system, world, monsters, battles.

milestones.title: PC build compiles
milestones.detail: CMake + MSVC/Clang build of the decompiled code for Windows x64.

milestones.title: Platform layer
milestones.detail: Replace the Wii SDK: GX→OpenGL/Vulkan, AX→SDL audio, WPAD→gamepad + mouse pointer, DVD/NAND→files.

milestones.title: Asset formats
milestones.detail: .sir containers (PNP0), DSP-ADPCM audio, Bink video, MIDI + wavetable music.

milestones.title: Playable
milestones.detail: Full game playable from start to finish on PC.

changelog.text: Progress site restyled as a mad-scientist lab: riveted metal panels, wooden shelves, slime-filled test tubes.
Decompiled the boot path (main, SysInit, crash handler, exit handling) and the top-level game loop.
Identified 50+ SDK functions from error strings and call patterns; fixed dtk re-analysis (.sbss2, computed-jump entries).
Project set up: disc extracted, main.dol split with decomp-toolkit, progress site launched.
